identity: 國立政治大學山下校區果夫樓；原1020面幾何不變之歷史瓦坡限域配色
scope: Only 10 whole original main-courtyard roof triangles and 9 whole original left-inner-wing roof triangles receive gray-green tile proxy. Other 1001 triangles remain neutral. Not a new geometry model, complete material reconstruction or 2026 roof condition claim.
source_assessment: Official historic front and side pixels show a green/gray-green tile finish on the main forecourt-facing roof and left inner-wing roof. Side source also distinguishes roof slopes from concrete entrance parapet, frames and fascia.

The official memory-page caption dates both historic photos to 2009. Front file has EXIF DateTime 2009:05:08 11:04:05; this is not independent DateTimeOriginal proof. Side file has no date EXIF; its date remains caption-based.
2025 supplementary entry crop is not sufficient to establish unchanged roof shade; visible tiles are strongly lit. No 2026 appearance claim is accepted.
Gray-green #647B60 is an uncalibrated opaque visual proxy, not a measured paint specification. Neutral #AAA79F denotes unconfirmed material, not that those real-world surfaces are all gray.

final_five_images_personally_viewed.assessment: Two source-supported inner/front roof areas colored; central portal, window recesses, eaves and both wing end roofs neutral. No visible overpaint.
Rear wall and rear main slope neutral. A small left-wing inner-plane sliver can be seen from this camera; independent full-vertex polygon test confirms it is not a rear-slope triangle.
Main courtyard slope green, portal and front roof/fascia boundaries neutral. No roof color spills onto vertical walls.
Oblique side camera shows selected inner planes through the forecourt while outer wing slope/end wall stay neutral. Complete mesh remains within frame.

Bounded L-like pair of sloping planes is clear. Ridges, narrow top flats, other slopes and entrance flat roof are not colored. Small upper-left triangular continuation is part of the same original left-inner plane, not evidence that an independently hidden back roof was observed.

independent_geometry_and_material_checks.method: Direct raw binary STL and 3MF XML; derive roof quadrilateral corners from the unchanged original hip-extrusion dimensions, then test all vertices against supporting-plane distance and all convex edge halfspaces. No builder classifier or probe function imported.
independent_geometry_and_material_checks.left_rear_sliver_limit: Included only as the continuation of the same source-supported, precisely bounded original slope. No claim that every small patch was separately photographed.

builder_report_boundary: Builder reports strict 3MF zero warnings, real material edit/save/reopen, original-native geometry match and clean 8-file rebuild byte equality with semantic Blend equality. I independently checked raw STL/3MF and material boundaries; I did not rerun the whole render/rebuild or edit test myself.
unchanged_geometry_limits: Original back-wall simplification and original fine feature/print limitations are not cured by adding color.
No slicing, FFF multi-material fabrication or physical print was performed by this review. No support-free/strength guarantee.
No private original source photos, page HTML or this research imagery should be publicly redistributed.
